meta.name: review-animations
meta.description: Reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar derived from Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy. Default to flagging; approval is earned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查动画代码,标记未达设计标准的动效实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果:你重视动效品质,希望在代码评审中由高标准把关。
copy.tagline_en: Review animation code and flag anything below a high design bar.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you value motion quality and want design-driven animation code review.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 只做动效审查:对照十条工艺标准逐项检查代码,默认挑毛病,输出「改前/改后/原因」问题表和 Block/Approve 裁决,并引用文件行号与标准数值。不做其他开发。
howto.when: 用户提交动画/动效代码并请求审查时触发,如转场、缓动、缩放、进入退出、手势动画等。要求审查一般代码时不会接管。

say.text: 检查这段弹窗动效,transform-origin 是不是写错了?
say.note: 会按物理正确性标准检验。

say.text: 这个按钮 hover 动画没加减少动态偏好,帮我审查。
say.note: 会标记为可访问性问题。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude reviews only animation/motion code: checks it against ten craft standards, defaults to flagging, and outputs a before/after/why findings table plus a Block/Approve verdict with file:line references and exact values. It won't do other development.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to review animation or motion code, e.g. transitions, easing, scale/entrance, gesture-driven motion. It declines general code review requests.

say_en.text: Review this dropdown transition — it uses transition: all 300ms.
say_en.note: Outputs a findings table with concrete fixes.

say_en.text: Check this modal animation; is the transform-origin wrong?
This hover animation lacks reduced-motion handling — review it.
say_en.note: Flags it as an accessibility finding.
